name: ListHub
positioning: Listing syndication and reporting for MLSs, brokers and agents, plus a normalized MLS data feed for the publishers that display those listings.
description: ListHub is a syndication platform operated by Move, Inc. that takes listing data out of a multiple listing service and distributes it to a network of more than 170 real estate websites. It serves two sides of the same pipe: on one side MLSs, brokerages and agents who decide where their listings travel and who read back performance reports on each destination; on the other side publishers, who consume MLS content through a customizable API covering sources in all fifty states under a single contract, delivered in RESO-normalized form. A separate Global offering pushes listings to overseas audiences, and a Connector product synchronizes with Realogy's database.
real_estate_use: A broker of record who has just signed a listing does not want to re-key it into every portal, and does not want it appearing on sites they never agreed to. They connect their MLS feed to ListHub once, then use the dashboard to opt each publisher in or out, and read the per-site reporting to see which destinations actually produced views and leads before renewing anything. On the other side of the same platform, a portal or a regional real estate magazine that needs live inventory subscribes to the publisher API rather than negotiating with hundreds of MLSs one by one.
features: Listing syndication to a network of over 170 real estate websites
Per-publisher opt-in and opt-out control for brokers
Listing performance reporting across destination sites
Publisher API delivering RESO-normalized MLS data from all 50 states
ListHub Global for international listing distribution

use_cases.job: Decide site by site where the office's listings are syndicated, and withdraw from a publisher without touching the MLS entry
Check which destination websites generated views on a listing before renewing an advertising commitment
Source live, normalized MLS listing data through one API instead of contracting with each MLS separately
